## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the home-directory boundary before merge: traversal paths and escaping symlinks allow previews of outside files. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a 200-character file preview helper, a settings-file path helper, and tests for both.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before enforcing the home boundary — For home `/srv/home` and relative `../secret.txt`, the check accepts `/srv/home/../secret.txt`, allowing `read_text()` to return an outside file. This lexical check also accepts an in-home symlink targeting an outside file. — When preview paths contain traversal components or escaping symlinks, callers can disclose readable files beyond the selected home directory. — Fix: Resolve both paths before checking containment, and extend `test_preview` with traversal and escaping-symlink cases.
